fusions.name: Herd Shove
fusions.desc: Shoves outward with your whole flank, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocking each back 2.5 tiles and healing you for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Grazing Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes a tail at a target up to 5 tiles away, dealing 4 damage and healing you for 10% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Warm Hollow
fusions.desc: Curls around a patch of ground 4 tiles across for 10 seconds, restoring 3 health a second to you and your allies inside it.

fusions.name: Huddle Down
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you regain 4 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.
